registration_scope: Diagnostic analysis protocol after E4 results were inspected; not fresh-test efficacy preregistration or a claim that analysis code is implemented.
existing_information: E4/E3c aggregate reports, source code and artifact locations inspected; no E4b candidate-level audit, reference-quality measurements or oracle replay computed.

specification.experiment: E4b reference-plane quality and decision-path audit
specification.analysis_type: retrospective diagnostic after E4 aggregate results were inspected
specification.scene_policy: All scenes have been inspected in earlier experiments; none is a fresh efficacy test. Resolve baseline, scores, datasets and labels through the E4/E3c source configurations, including inherited sources.
specification.candidate_scope: Every original-active Gaussian; exclude rank_only and policy_fallback removal from method attribution

labels.policy: Reuse frozen E4 labels and their actual scene-specific manifests; do not relabel to increase agreement. Unknown is separate and never normal or bad.

cohorts.controls: All active labeled normals, reporting the same four B6/P2 decision partitions; active unknowns reported separately

replay.thresholds: Frozen E4 seal, strict score > threshold; no retuning
replay.snapshots: Every actual decision event from candidate birth onward with its own poses, Sim(3) scales and revision; no future raw observations
replay.source_rule: Preserve candidate/evidence source-image disjointness; do not claim mutually independent evidence or predictors
replay.comparison_time: For B6-only bad, primary anchor is B6 first_reject with stored reject_revision; compare all methods at that same snapshot, then report the complete subsequent history
replay.other_cohort_time: First rejection by either method; if neither rejects, use first shared-2plus snapshot, else birth; always retain complete history
replay.integrity_requirement: Recomputed snapshot scores, finite masks, natural membership and first rejection must reproduce frozen artifacts before interpreting causes; preserve original float32/NaN arithmetic
replay.native_b6: Median of finite native depth observations, possibly one view; no plane-PCA mask or plane-zero veto
replay.matched_controls: D_maskmedian and D_shared use P2 shared per-view masks, >=2 views and plane-zero veto; D_shared uses second largest, D_maskmedian median

reference_quality.gt_masks: Exact E1/E4 resize, crop, camera and GT depth-edge exclusion; missing, boundary or nonplanar GT patches remain unassessable for plane quality
reference_quality.gt_plane_fit: Unproject the matched evidence pixel's 5x5 GT patch with calibrated K; equal-weight PCA on the common predicted-valid and GT-valid nonedge pixels; orient normal toward camera
reference_quality.gt_plane_reliability: Use frozen E2 eigenvalue ratios: smallest/middle <=0.1, middle/largest >=0.05, and positive middle eigenvalue; no learned confidence on GT
reference_quality.predicted_plane: The exact original predicted patch plane; never refit it using the GT-valid subset in the factual replay
reference_quality.scale: Inherited label-manifest global alignment scale times evidence pose scale at the actual snapshot; no patchwise or depth-fitted alignment
reference_quality.own_view_check: Compare scaled raw pointmap z with GT at its source pixel; separately report predicted-ray versus calibrated-ray angle and calibrated projection depth errors. Do not equate source-pixel z agreement with full 3D correctness.
reference_quality.coherent_wrong_rule: Among >=9 common pixels, >=80% have same-sign source-pixel z error beyond each pixel's tolerance; predicted patch must pass its original reliability gate. Report front and behind separately, exact all-pixels-wrong flag and continuous errors as well.
reference_quality.shared_wrong_support: Missed GT-bad candidate, original finite plane score exactly zero, reliable GT reference plane is displaced or tilted, and candidate is independently GT-front in the same evidence view under the frozen 3-sigma/tolerance rule. Require calibrated projection inside the tested patch; otherwise mark correspondence ambiguous. Coherent_wrong is a separate stricter tag, not inferred from plane error alone.
reference_quality.pose_sensitivity: Separate own-view reference error from errors after decision-time estimated relative placement; compare GT-anchor relative placement without refitting scale. Pose sensitivity is diagnostic only.

attribution.overlap_policy: Keep all gate flags and reference-error tags in addition to the ordered funnel; co-occurrence does not establish a unique cause
attribution.factor_control: Use native B6 -> D_maskmedian -> D_shared -> P2 as descriptive contrasts of eligibility/veto, aggregation and residual, respectively. Different frozen thresholds and interactions prevent claiming a pure causal decomposition.

oracle.role: Required secondary diagnostic, not a deployable algorithm or efficacy result
oracle.eligible_pairs: Original finite shared pairs whose GT plane is reliable; unsupported GT pairs retain factual values in every arm and are counted separately. Never create evidence where factual eligibility was missing.
oracle.replacement: Replace only plane mean and normal with the corresponding GT plane expressed in predicted evidence-camera units. Keep candidate means/covariance, estimated poses, raw ray match IDs, finite masks, radius/spacing normalization, aggregation and thresholds fixed; recompute normal-projected sigma from the unchanged covariance.
oracle.fixed_veto: Keep factual support-veto booleans to isolate score changes on the factual gate; factual_common and this arm have identical finite eligibility
oracle.recomputed_veto: Recompute plane-zero veto from replaced scores on the SAME original shared pairs; this tests reference influence through support while leaving all other gates fixed
oracle.temporal_policy: Replay each arm from birth independently with absorbing REJECT; never revive factual rejects or overwrite factual decisions
oracle.limitation: Oracle plane quality depends on GT planarity and fixed correspondence. Missing GT, poor original masks, and pose errors can conceal reference effects; zero recovery does not refute shared bias. No claim about rendered Chamfer improvement without separate map evaluation.

visualization.sampling: Uniform without replacement over sorted stable candidate IDs within each cohort; use all if fewer. Publish selected IDs before inspecting per-case plots; do not replace inconvenient or unauditable examples.

specification.completion: Complete only after exact factual replay, all predefined cohort/gate/reference denominators including unknowns, both oracle contrasts, pose sensitivity and fixed examples are reported. Incomplete stages or replay mismatch are explicit, not a positive result.

conclusions.shared_wrong_support_observed: Report candidate and unique-patch counts satisfying the strict tag with traceable examples; occurrence alone does not establish prevalence or predictor causality
conclusions.reference_quality_contributes: Require same-candidate GT-reference error plus a factual-to-oracle nonreject-to-reject transition; separately report all normal harms and lost bad rejections
conclusions.not_established_or_unassessable: No qualifying observations or inadequate GT/pose/correspondence coverage; do not infer all reference planes are correct
conclusions.efficacy: No GO threshold and no dominant-cause claim. Preserve E4 REVISE and E5/E6 hold; any algorithm change needs a separately frozen evaluation on uninspected data.

specification.execution_scope: Protocol only at registration; analysis implementation, per-case computation, oracle replay and figures are pending. Reuse saved E4 baselines; no SLAM/model training, threshold tuning or E4 artifact mutation.

input_hash_scope: Anchor manifests/configs/reports only at planning time. Execution must validate their referenced artifacts and write a complete input manifest before analysis; this is not a full raw-data integrity verification.
amendment_policy: Preserve this registration; document any protocol change and analysis exposure before running the amended analysis.
